positions.subject: q:housing/citywide-rezoning
positions.summary: Her platform supports housing near transit and commercial corridors, including 7- to 8-story buildings where infrastructure fits, while protecting quiet residential blocks from out-of-scale development; she opposes the proposed 25-story Marina Safeway tower.

citations.quote: Responsible growth near transit and commercial corridors
7- to 8-story housing where it fits neighborhood infrastructure
Protect quiet residential blocks from out-of-scale development
No support for the proposed 25-story Marina Safeway tower
